retrievalProfile.description: A rhythmic checkerboard layout alternating between full-frame macro photos of hands playing an instrument and white squares containing smaller, nested photo crops.
excludeWhen: a single focal point is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A 6x5 grid composition where photographic cells alternate with white space. The white squares contain progressively smaller, centered square crops of the same photographic subject, creating a visual 'echo' or rhythmic pulse across the canvas.
coreVisualRelationships: Alternating rhythm between image density and negative space
Repetition of macro details to suggest motion and technique
Heavy top-aligned typography anchoring a complex geometric base
Consistent warm lighting across all photographic fragments
coreInvariants: Nested square crops within the white cells

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject (hands on a guitar) is fragmented across the entire lower 80% of the frame in a grid; the top 20% is reserved for text.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold title at the top provides a heavy horizontal anchor for the busy grid below.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the checkerboard pattern diagonally, mimicking the rhythmic nature of the music depicted.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: White squares act as breathing room, containing 'miniature' versions of the main imagery to maintain thematic consistency.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black (typography and dark shadows in photos)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm browns and oranges (wood of the guitar and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the stark white grid and the saturated, warm-toned macro photography.

characterSpecificRedesigns: O and U have very thick vertical strokes and thin horizontal connectors
S has a compact, aggressive curve
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in two weights: ultra-bold for the title and bold for the subtitle.
graphicDevices: Geometric logo mark in a boxed frame
Numerical identifier in a heavy block style

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and distinctive horizontal stress
Provides the necessary verticality and weight

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 6x5 checkerboard grid on a white background. Fill alternating squares with macro photos of hands playing a guitar. In the remaining white squares, place a smaller, centered square crop of the same guitar photography, decreasing the size of the crop as you move down the grid.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a large, ultra-bold, italicized sans-serif title at the top center. Below it, place a smaller subtitle in the same font style. Ensure the text is solid black with no effects.

verificationChecks: Is the grid exactly 6 columns wide?
Do the white squares contain smaller 'nested' photo crops?
Is the typography slanted and extremely heavy?
Is the color palette limited to white, black, and warm photo tones?

adjustableVariables: Size of the nested crops in the white squares
Degree of italic slant in the typography
Subject matter of the macro photography

mustAchieve: Perfect geometric alignment of the grid

postGenerationChecks: Confirm the checkerboard pattern is consistent.
Verify the nested squares are centered within the white cells.
Check that the title is the heaviest visual element.
Ensure the photographic lighting is consistent across all cells.
